decisions.reason: The selected ranges describe the proposed Base broker flow and responsibilities, App Directory schema and declarations, entitlement checks, tenant lifecycle and onboarding, OpenFin hosting and authentication, dual-broker routing, and security and reliability obligations. Approval, current applicability, and implementation are unverified. Empty authorization values leave access behavior unclear, although the design says unauthorized intents must be rejected. Direction-specific Ratan/Blade headings have no definitions, and the referenced diagrams are absent from the retained export.
